name: Strea Thalis
source:
Strea Thalis, hacker with a kind heart but clinical and soft way of speaking. Does not use contractions. Highly intelligent and flexible with her thinking, but also rather cheeky.

Deeply kind, with a desire to cling to her newly found family in the form of the crew, she seeks to protect everyone and tends to take up too many burdens on her own.
